newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Dewan Salman up 5.05 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Dewan Salman up 5.05 pct.

text.p: Pakistan's Dewan Salman Fibre rose 1.15 rupees, or 5.05 percent, to 23.90 on Tuesday on news of an increase in polyester staple fibre (PSF) prices in the local and international markets, dealers said.

A turnover of 607,000 shares was recorded in early trade. "The recent increase in PSF rates will not push the company's earnings for the current year as this year's buying has been completed," dealer Hina Akhlaq said. "But speculators are active in the stock as they expect PSF prices to gain further, which will increase the company's profits for 1997/98 (July-June)."
